non_blocking.section: Commits and pull requests (Pull request rules, Reviews row)
non_blocking.suggestion: ADR-0002 Confirmation says 'scan allowlist edits need maintainer review'. Line 439 lists the paths that need two approvals ('api/, pkg/, docs/_meta/, security-sensitive packages and go.mod') but not the no-license-check allowlist file. Add that file to the two-approval list and to CODEOWNERS, so an entry cannot quietly allow an entitlement check.

ADR-0002 scopes the non-Go license gate to 'any dependency shipped in the artifact (not build-only tooling such as proc-macros)' and accepts a named per-ecosystem addendum such as Unicode-3.0. The document says 'lockfile license gate (G2)'. Consider 'license gate (G2 allowlist and per-ecosystem addendum) over shipped lockfile dependencies' so the wording matches the ADR. The Go PDK has go.sum rather than a lockfile, so stage 3 could say 'each PDK's shipped dependencies'.

The nightly supply-chain rescan covers only the Go gate. Consider also rescanning the Console and PDK lockfiles, so a license change in an existing npm, Cargo or NuGet dependency is caught between pull requests. The tooling for this still waits on OQ-repository-layout-and-conventions-3.

Testing and quality strategy triggers pr-full on 'Go, proto or schema changes'. Line 447 adds examples. Either propose that addition to the testing document or note that it comes from this document, so the two trigger lists do not drift apart.

Foundation pack section 9 also defines `ruralz version` and `ruralz completion` outside the noun-verb form. Consider naming where they live, for example `internal/cli/root`, so a contributor does not create a ninth noun package.
